blocks.title: Singleton pattern
blocks.text: Singleton design pattern yaqeeni banata hai ke koi khaas object ya resource program mein sirf ek baar bane aur jab bhi zaroorat ho dobara istemal ho.
Ise khaas kamre ki sirf ek chaabi jaisa samjhein: jo bhi andar jana chahe, sab wahi ek chaabi istemal karte hain. Nayi chaabiyan nahi banti, aur sab ek hi chaabi baant-te hain.

blocks.prompt: Software ki koi misal dijiye jahan kisi qism ka sirf ek object hona chahiye.
blocks.explanation: Maslan application ka ek hi settings (configuration) object, ya database ka ek mushtarka connection manager, jise program ka har hissa apna banane ki bajaye istemal karta hai.

items: Singleton: object ek baar ban kar har jagah mushtarka, khaas kamre ki ek chaabi ki tarah.
